SELECT channel_code, channel_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, min(etl_loaded_at) e1, max(etl_loaded_at) e2

SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.status='cancelled' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) cancelled_net, sum(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order_hdr,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ts_date_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_id=3 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) cc_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_qty
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.sale_date, CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) utc_date, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', f.sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) hel_date, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, min(f.sale_ts_utc) t1, max(f.sale_ts_utc) t2
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' k, count(*) n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_overlap', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND s.channel_id IN (2,3)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_overlap_in_fact', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND s.channel_id IN (2,3)
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_vs_order_header_mismatch', count(*) FROM (SELECT f.receipt_id, count(*) c, any_value(w.line_count) lc FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)<>any_value(w.line_count))
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_store_keys', count(DISTINCT store_key) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'

SELECT f.sale_date, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross, round(sum(gross_amount)/sum(net_amount),4) ratio,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_incons,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.status<>'cancelled' THEN f.receipt_id END) live_orders,
 (SELECT sum(order_total_gross) FROM fact_web_order w2 WHERE w2.status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', w2.order_ts_utc)) AS DATE)=f.sale_date) hdr_gross_live,
 (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE s.channel_id IN (2,3) AND r.return_date=f.sale_date) refunds_net_by_return_date
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.format, count(*) n, min(f.sale_date) d1, max(f.sale_date) d2

WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY ALL

WITH rpt AS (SELECT business_date d, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) r, sum(net_sales) n, sum(receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-17' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
 s AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(f.net_amount) b_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) b_nostaff, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) rc FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.channel_id=1 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-17' GROUP BY 1),
 r AS (SELECT r.return_date d, sum(r.refund_net) rn, sum(CASE WHEN s.channel_id=1 THEN r.refund_net END) rn_store FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-17' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rpt.d, rpt.b, rpt.r, rpt.n, rpt.rc, s.b_all, s.b_nostaff, s.rc, r.rn, r.rn_store FROM rpt JOIN s USING (d) JOIN r USING (d) ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.return_date, s.channel_id, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, count(DISTINCT r.store_key) stores, min(r.store_key) k, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', r.return_ts_utc)) AS DATE)<>r.return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tz_diff, sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<s.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND s.channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH days AS (
  SELECT calendar_date AS sale_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
), sales AS (
  SELECT sale_date, sum(net_amount) AS sales_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2, 3) GROUP BY sale_date
), refunds AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS sale_date, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE s.channel_id IN (2, 3) GROUP BY r.return_date
)
SELECT d.sale_date AS business_date,
       CAST(coalesce(s.sales_before_returns, 0) - coalesce(r.returns_net, 0) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS web_net_sales,
       s.sales_before_returns, r.returns_net
FROM days d LEFT JOIN sales s USING (sale_date) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sale_date)
ORDER BY 1
